# Wattle Health Fund

Silver Plus Hospital and Mid Extras

Membership [POLICY_1] · Adult 1: [MEMBER_A] · Partner: [MEMBER_B]

## Hospital cover

| Clinical category | Status |
|---|---|
| Joint replacements | Covered |
| Insulin pumps | Restricted |
| Pregnancy and birth | Not covered |

Excess: $500 per person per calendar year, payable once per admission.

## Extras

| Service | Item | Benefit |
|---|---|---|
| Physiotherapy initial consultation | 500 | $55.00 |
| Physiotherapy subsequent consultation | 505 | $45.00 |

Physiotherapy and chiropractic share a combined limit of $700 per person per calendar year. Waiting period: 2 months.

## Claiming

Extras claims must be lodged within 2 years of the date of service.
